blocks.text:
## What you will remember about this trip

Antigua was Guatemala's third capital and retains buildings that reflect the country's colonial history. In Chichicastenango, the route takes you to a large highland Maya market held on Thursdays and Sundays. At Lake Atitlán, you will visit San Juan, discover local weaving traditions and workshops, and then travel by boat to Santiago Atitlán.

The final part of the journey focuses on Tikal, the largest settlement in pre-Columbian America. Here, the ancient city is surrounded by tropical jungle, with pyramid temples rising above the forest.
